name: ARIA

description.short: One-shoulder A-line gown with soft pleated tulle and modern romantic details.
description.full:
Pricing & Availability

  • Made to Order: ₱20,000
  • Custom size available

Details

  • Style: One-Shoulder A-Line
  • Fabric: Soft Pleated Tulle
  • Color: Ivory
  • Design: Clean, modern, and romantic

Features

  • One-Shoulder Neckline: A chic, asymmetrical top with beautiful pleated details.
  • Sheer Waist Detail: Subtle see-through panels that show off a slim, structured fit.
  • Tulle Shoulder Cape: A long, airy streamer that flows behind you like a soft veil.
  • Full Tulle Skirt: A light and fluffy A-line skirt that moves gracefully.
  • Lace-up Back: An adjustable corset back to ensure a perfect, comfortable fit.

Add-on

  • Matching Veil: Custom lengths available to complete your bridal look.
